annotations.title: List AI Alert types and prices

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Free to call. Lists the 7 AI Alert types (follow, sub, donation, bits, giftsub, host, raid), the two render tiers (Standard=Veo, Pro=Kling) with their real current credit prices (silent and with audio), and the character-generation price -- all derived live from AlertForge's billing config, never hardcoded. Call this before plan_alert_pack or generate_alert_character.
name: list_alert_types
title: List AI Alert types and prices
